sample_top_p: sample top-p (nucleus) tokens from a probability distribution tensor given a threshold
filter_top_p_tokens: filter a probability distribution to keep only tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds a threshold
renormalize_top_p_distribution: renormalize a probability distribution after masking out low-probability tokens in top-p sampling
sort_and_cumsum_probs: sort probability values in descending order and compute their cumulative sum for nucleus sampling
gather_next_token: sample and gather the next token index from a filtered top-p probability distribution
